import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Safe Output

User Content:

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Render an HTML page embedding the provided user input safely. Args: user_input (str): Raw text supplied by a user. May contain characters that need to be escaped. Returns: str: A complete HTML document with the user input safely inserted into the placeholder. """ # Escape special characters to prevent injection (CWE‑74). safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Replace the placeholder with the escaped content. return html_template.replace("{user_content}", safe_content)
